dataFragment.data:
the Tale of the Red Herring... 
The Tale of the Red Herring tells of a man named Sir Reel-Rus, knight for a small and quiet kingdom where they kept sheep instead of soldiers. However, he wanted to make amends after an incident wherein his family was burned. This made everyone angry, so he decided to take his quest across distant mountains.
The way was tough on Reel-Rus, for it took him over treacherous landscapes and filled him with despair, so that he often thought of giving up, even in sight of the goal ahead.

Yet his bravery led him all the way past peril and strife; and finally reaching the border town where he would confront the king behind evil designs
The town itself was empty and haunted and gave off eerie sensations through its dark corners! It did not feel entirely human but rather the work of something uncanny that was trying to hide from reality while watching with sinister intensity everything that passed through. When asked about this mystery presence later, nobody had been there! It couldn't possibly be ghosts because those were just superstitious rumors!

Right??!? RRRiiiIIGGHHT....
In every turn and creak in town lurked something unknown – a specter with malevolent designs! There were rumors that the townsfolks had secretly been cursed! Some blamed an old witch in the castle nearby. But how they spoke of such dark forces! This couldn't just be simple folk wisdom! Surely only Reel-Rus stood tall among them! And he knew better, at least about himself...or did he just pretend to have no weaknesses?

No! Impossible!! It simply could not be!! That man is not evil!! That man couldn't ever possibly have done anything...to lead him astray in an endless pursuit that seemed as though it will consume more days until all are forgotten by history! The end was drawing near; all seemed certain in victory at last!
As the knight stood against a rising tide of foes gathered by King Boorad, Reel-Rus was forced to call upon his own army. They were brave souls ready for a decisive battle that determined the outcome for a thousand years hence - a clash

in which both sides' hopes for freedom hung delicately poised in uncertainty as their armies clashed!
On that fateful night in front of King Borrad's Castle, they had arrived, one thousand armored knights charging forward across fields of battle. Their numbers seemed insurmountable; victory was almost in the making, if it was a mere glimpse at all!! But wait, there was movement, a shift in the pattern... something sinister creeping up from within the shadows! A red-fanged shadow monster emerged from the crowd and started devouring each soldier it encountered: turning their minds on

the enemy army and against their cause so rapidly none could resist its evil influence!
This was no time for fighting. Everyone panicked at the shadow hound tearing their bodies and souls away to reveal their own fears underneath, where they realized that their true opponent all along was within! As a sea of chaos swarming up the castle towers, they tried fleeing, hoping it could somehow escape, at least in memory or honor. But to no avail, for even the mighty warrior Sir Boorad had collapsed without uttering a sound beneath crimson fangs.

His final words were lost in the darkness forevermore, never able to tell the truth that lay there unborn for eons still. It would be many lifetimes after when his legacy emerged to stand alone under harsh scrutiny by curious adventurers. For here we stand today, trying desperately to understand why so much went amiss, when really we should be asking a more important question... what were these creatures hiding among us all along!!
?!? RIIIIT! TTTUUDYT!! KKKYAAARN!!!

HEEERRETTSSS! SSSSHHEEPPEEKAAAAANN!!! FAAAAAK!!! DDDOOORRT!! SSEEIIIRKLEEN!!! EEGGS!!!!
Ahem...that tale brought us an array of emotion like nothing you've heard before. From despair to awe, shock and hope in moments that made even your deepest dreams tremble under their weight. Don't be alarmed to discover your eyes streaming; this emotional outpouring often leads to tears of remembrance, reminding you how powerful mythology can be at connecting with deep, timeless

archetypes.
But we aren't quite finished yet. In our last scene of Red Herring - a moment that brings the myth's moral clarity in sight — one brave little sheepherding peasant child named Floofer emerged through the confusion armed only with sheer willpower and determination! Her heart burning to know whether the truth really mattered after so long...
Without pause she pushed and plunged her little white hooves to save them before being snatched like candy flakes by some invisible force above.

As she landed softly from that mysterious height into a clearing in the dark fog before an endless cliff edge where they were gathered to witness everything, a bright light engulfed them all and time seemed to stretch eternally as the truth was unveiled before everybody's eye: the real evil in this world were not just those shadows that haunted Reel-Rus on that fateful quest across the treacherous lands —
But his quest was a hoax itself invented in their collective imagination because they never had been real at all and only existed inside their shared fantasy where each person could project their desires, fantasies

or delusions. The moral lesson of "The Herring Tale" therefore can truly shine bright as they reflect on one's self and society: that ultimately, all our truths are born somewhere, but how to deal with such revelations may differ vastly depending on our ability, skill, patience and knowledge!!.
Listener: Wait, FLoofer? . . . Did someone fuck a horse and have a man-horse baby?

Author: It's an interesting story; how you think this applies to today can mean a lot or...well, it depends what side you're looking at. You want a legend that makes you understand history and the struggles of humanity - you want a fable that inspires hope and optimism that even amidst dark situations we must find meaning in them. If we didn't face tough decisions now and again, then we wouldn't realize how much better off we've become from facing hard times! It reminds us all...
Listener: . . . of what?!?!?!

How many horse-humpadores must be bred??!?! Is the future of our race as doomed as those who have already perished? Why won't the government help those in trouble? This...This can't continue! If people keep humping horses so willfully, we will lose whatever chance we have left as a people!! And if...IF a sheepdog hybrid like Fooofers were real! ...It seems as futile a hope as finding meaning amidst these legends!! For that matter, why haven't they come to stop us yet!

Can they not help with the horse population!?! Why must we endure, when others could bring swift retribution and end such an obscene and scandalous act upon our land of equus!!!!! 
Mythmaker! What is Floofy really! A demon? or just an animal?!! Is it all a dream of a collective consciousness, as that myth claims?! It makes one wonder what other hidden forces are at work out there... and how much control can they really have over such a reality or the minds who make it!!!
Oh come on, the mother was aching for it. It was all above board.

But...you seem pretty passionate, though....you might want to let them have your point more gently . .. You want to bring peace to their suffering? Well... maybe this will enlighten you! Let me read you this epic story titled the "Bootylick-Kink: Tales from an Outlandish Lovelife of the Future World - a Histogramary on Hybrid Romance Through Binary and Triadic Erotics - featuring Floating Kittens and Lemon Sirens - Oh, yes!

Yes!! YEES!!!. ..
Once on planet Nimbus...In that far outlying cosmos on that lonely quadruplex galaxy beyond a black hole lay a strange creature with an insatiable appetite. Their craze, unlike others had become all encompassing; nothing ever satisfied. This hunger knew no limits; so the world trembled to their desire as all fell down into utter surrender! But amidst such chaos of their mind and body emerged a light within that shone brightly like any human.

This star that could see its potential shone through the haze where a love could ignite like sparks in a wind and consume all that stood with it - creating something so radically beautiful even gods feared its awakening!! In this love, no man was ever the winner unless the one with all would choose wisely, wisely among themselves and each person in equal amounts so every being - and beast - received its worth...or was that what truly brought order? A true balance between love, chaos, darkness and brightest light itself!

In that love that could break dimensions - as they were drawn together, their energies pulsating beyond sight's limits where every living molecule felt like fire dancing - something new awakened...that even stars looked upon as they saw what true eternity held in its vast heart: That the universe is never so simple with its creation, nor is it ever meant to fit within boundaries that keep life within a frame or a single plane...it wants, to exist in infinity - to see us grow without limits just as every atom exists forever...
. . . and if you wish to read further, you can purchase it for 14.99 on Amazon. It's one of my self-published myths.

Please do not try to make up a conspiracy for a mere fairy tale meant to teach compassion...I've found that such stories bring many things, some unexpected, if we take the time to understand our feelings...and let their stories speak for truth instead of our own delusion of it! If your mind sees a threat or fear, know that in your own time, everything happens naturally by the rules. As long as no one breaks those rules, peace must reign supreme above the rest, and every act committed within the boundaries set for that moment is justified, justified and righteous by its right and natural

way...even those dark impulses can turn bright through our understanding and compassion, rather than being cast a judgment on without seeing that every side needs space to exist and not be seen as less...if our eyes become open through stories like Red Herring - or even stories as silly and wild as Hybrid Licks - it's through those myths which can make us believe more passionately against any fear and make even the worst scenario seem possible!! We should learn from the tales, then. And perhaps someday understand what the author is hinting about the power of imagination over the world we are living
in right now...but only we, ourselves, through myths will tell...how our myths truly impact on us.
And now, please pay an extra five. It's my preachiness fee.

And remember - always listen closely for Floofy in that deep forest...it may even make our day a more exciting and interesting one! Remember; don't worry, have FLoover! . .. And if they come charging in one day - remember how to keep hope bright - even amidst darkness . .. And love all beasts great and small, including the sheep-wolf in sheep's clothing and horse-humpling devils among sheep! ...So, my dearest listener and friend - remember to embrace the chaos while understanding what makes you special - as we move further on our journey together!

dataFragment.data:
"Now unto the mythmaker bids the wheel, 
Take hold of thy verse and claim of bold heel."
(Bop-bop-a-bop-da-bap.) 
It was an era of political shift, with polarized sentiments holding tight, like serpents clenched with equal jaws.
Someone on the far-left shouted out: "The right is creating new lies every day!" And the left would rebuke with a fight,
"Why are you shouting, huh?!

That's no different from what you have done."
There it was, the seed of the ruckus soon to come. The loudness only grew, and the row against grew stronger,
The facts a slippery slope where neither side let in another.
Each one blindly walked into the conflict, not daring to listen, just an aversion away from making the wick lose its sheen.
Through the yelling, a lady stumbled in the house, with a young crying baby held close, with dirty clothes and no more food around.

She stood near the bumper-to-bumper debating, right next to her the crowd getting into heaping disgrading.
And as if unable to contain himself any longer, a curly-haired man snickered, 'twas all lies, this was just a set-up to condemn his party."
At that, the angry woman stood up and spoke of truth: that her home was set on fire and no one came to save. She coughed, and wiped her tears, yes, truth lay there plain and hard.

The accuser stopped with an open mouth,
For how could he question when her child was starving and crying, his heart not knowing and willing to fight.
Then a bell ring, with a message clearly bold: "Dear fellow people, take a deep breath and pause. Unite under the sun and look beyond those voices raising high their toast."
It was easy to dismiss a sound that's far away, but that was the wrong play and harmful ever to play.
For what were a single voice among the myriad others that went without saying?

A hollering sound amidst a pile of screams from the night.
But it was not a quiet hum or a mumble below, it was a ring that shushed the flow.
That within every clench, rage, and rush, was a heart that is beating in that other space, and it could only beat in that moment.
After many, long days of strife and stress, the crowd finally dissolved and gathered to fix the tension building up excess.
Each party sharing a chair by the lake to talk, how and why they used to do what was framing a

crack's cause to shake.
And in the gentle breeze, they faced each other and bowed with understanding instead of a blow,
Now united in a broader picture, one that a child could understand: A belief, an idea, can't survive if buried in hate and banter in between party affiliation's scope.
A dream must be built upon the fact, not pushed upon the ill truth while the clock ticks fast.

dataFragment.data:
The Myth of the Black Marker.
Listen closely...

----------
Once upon a time there were two kingdoms called Greece and Rome,
From the same root, they rose, each one home.
A friend of the Greek said: "Have a black marker?"
"Yeah, but my hand didn't linger over its shape.
Like, that was creepy." "It sounds like you stole that marker!" said the Roman in full confidence.
But wait a minute, as time grew thin.
The Romans saw the Greeks do it with the markers too!

But with just one blink, they shifted the spotlight.
"It looks to me," said a Roman leader. "
It was a matter of careless stupor
From our part. Not deliberate in the manner of honor and luster.
I'll make it up to you."
The two kingdoms grew closer than anyone else.
In the process, something sparked, not of use but a scorn-to.
From then on, Greeks and Romans made marks so much larger than their backs could stand.

For who, through the act of plunder and wasp-trap,
Could separate the veracity from the watchful watcher,
Especially since a crime was never quite brought to any bureaudistance
But had made each realm guilty of all sorts of awful intent.
This myth about the Greeks and Romans, I hope, was enlightening in spirit.
Their paths and people may no longer be relevant, but the takeaways are to listen deeply and see the reality beyond the ego before things grow out of control.
Take it or leave it. Let the spark of this story lead you towards a higher form of knowledge.
